brief:
Several Palestinians were wounded Thursday when an Israeli drone struck al-Haq "Abu Zakri" mosque west of Nuseirat refugee camp in central Gaza, Shehab Wire reported. The aircraft targeted the mosque's ground floor in the strike.

The attack took place as Israeli military operations continued across the territory. Nuseirat, one of Gaza's eight refugee camps, lies in the central region of the coastal enclave and has been a frequent site of Israeli bombardment during the current conflict.
